detaileddescription.para: Initialize the object related style manager module. Called by LVGL in lv_init()

Remove all styles from an object
obj
pointer to an object

Notify all object if a style is modified
style
pointer to a style. Only the objects with this style will be notified (NULL to notify all objects)

Notify an object and its children about its style is modified.
obj
pointer to an object
part
the part whose style was changed. E.g. LV_PART_ANY, LV_PART_MAIN
prop
LV_STYLE_PROP_ANY or an LV_STYLE_... property. It is used to optimize what needs to be refreshed. LV_STYLE_PROP_INV to perform only a style cache update

Enable or disable automatic style refreshing when a new style is added/removed to/from an object or any other style change happens.
en
true: enable refreshing; false: disable refreshing

Get the value of a style property. The current state of the object will be considered. Inherited properties will be inherited. If a property is not set a default value will be returned.
obj
pointer to an object
part
a part from which the property should be get
prop
the property to get
the value of the property. Should be read from the correct field of the lv_style_value_t according to the type of the property.
